name: first_hold_pitch_600
comment: First powered PITCH hold: the drone turned 90 deg in the cradle, so the pivot is the pitch axis; USB cable routed along the pivot. rig-pitch build (RIG_AXIS=1); roll_sp_mdeg, ROLL_TRIM and the step act on PITCH, RIG_PITCH_MAX_RAD guards the locked roll. Gains = the roll first-hold set (controller_pid.cpp flies pitch with the roll constants and J[1] = J[0]). Limits sized like first_hold_800.
